Change Listing to return the two groups (or a split point) so callers stop re-filtering? That changes the ns.Camp.Listing shape tests/campsites_spec.lua asserts.

items.what: BUG: ZoneDB source parse/evaluation failures become nil; Attach substitutes empty overrides or silently abandons initialization.
items.why: Table discards both loadstring and pcall errors. Attach replaces an unreadable areaIdToUiMapIdOverride with {}, so MapOf falls back to base maps even where an override should exclude or remap an area. Reproduced without writing fixtures: appended an in-memory probe to tests/questgivers_spec.lua, replaced only the support source with 'return { [12] = 0', then observed Attach() and needs.check() both true and Resolve('Di', 0, 1490, 500) returning NPC 5; the intact fixture returns nil because area 12 is excluded. With areaIdToUiMapId changed to 'return {', Attach() returned false and the initializer installed no tooltip callback, but needs.check() stayed true. Repository-wide searches found no other caller that surfaces the parse error or attachment failure. Settle it by reading Questie's icon type definitions for the Forever build, or in game with `/dump Questie.ICON_TYPE_AVAILABLE_GRAY`; a named local for 7 is then a behaviour-preserving edit.
